changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwencounterassessments AS SELECT ea.id, ea.patient_id, ea.encounter_id, ea.assessment, ea.created_date, ea.created_by, ea.last_modified_by, ea.last_modified_date FROM public.encounter_assessments ea;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwencounterassessments TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwencounterassessments FROM report_user;
